crossRefs.note: He set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the wide place at the gate of the city…
After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah…
and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words…

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: He brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,
translations.bsb: Then he brought in the priests and Levites and gathered them in the square on the east side.
translations.kjv: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
translations.asv: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the broad place on the east,
